item.text: The failure is confined to `slugify`: it only replaces whitespace, so punctuation survives and existing hyphens can repeat. I’ll normalize every run of non-alphanumeric characters to one hyphen and trim edge separators; this also handles underscores and mixed punctuation consistently. The requested focused regression test is already present, so I’ll extend it only with separator edge cases.
